title: A room with bouncing lines on screens.
content: Sometimes Mall World seems like a college campus to me. Different buildings that all seem familiar. Sometimes with noticeable plants or ivy in between. I'll wander around to the different buildings. While I'm there I'll remember the different jobs that I have, or what people are doing. In one dream, I went over to a building that looked like a gymnasium. In it, there were rows of monitors. Like CRT monitors, but different. There were wires everywhere. The monitors were placed in different configurations. And there were different input or interaction devices. Each monitor displayed a glowing green line that seem to move with a kind of thinking. There were people of all different ages there. There was a kind of workplace energy. People seemed to be very intent on what they were looking at with the green lines. I wasn't sure how I fit in. It seemed like the people there were professionals at what they were doing, but I wasn't completely sure what they were doing.
